text: The Patriots extended their mastery of the Jets to four straight with a 26-19 victory on Sunday, improving to 2-0 in the AFC East as Drake Maye's three touchdown passes proved sufficient to weather New York's late rally and maintain the team's third consecutive win. A.J. Brown's return from a four-week absence following his right high ankle sprain proved tentative, as the receiver dropped a career-high three passes in the comeback effort, though the silver lining came courtesy of Romeo Doubs, who hauled in a spectacular 42-yard touchdown grab from Maye with 4:10 remaining in the first quarter before suffering an injury on the play. Under Mike Vrabel's "never apologize for a win" philosophy, New England's locker room showed no regrets about the victory, a mentality that appears to be cementing itself as the coaching staff and its developing roster—which includes two rookies in starting roles—continue to build momentum heading forward.
